description:
## Problem
The old Python ETL (wrong XML structure, empty processing methods, synthetic rows), the old DataFrame path and `TPCDIMetrics` (an invented score) are unreachable.

## Owner decisions (choice dialogs, 2026-11-20 and 2026-11-21)
- 2026-11-20: "Public Python members of `TPCDI` and `TPCDIBenchmark` that only served the old path are removed; the list is shown in that pull request's description and the breaking changelog entry."
- 2026-11-21: the old `etl/` package was moved to `_legacy_etl/` in the ETL scaffolding step and is deleted after the milestone.

## Change
Delete `benchbox/core/tpcdi/_legacy_etl/`, the old `validation.py` and `metrics.py`, the old sections of `benchmark.py`, the facade methods in `benchbox/tpcdi.py`, the old DataFrame path, their tests, the matching api-public-symbols and soundness-path entries, and the matching rows of `docs/internal/tpc-measured-intervals.md`. Breaking changelog fragment listing the removed public members.

## Decision gates
The removed public member list and the changelog text are shown in the pull request description. If the deletion would exceed the review bot's limit, split by directory and say so.

## Verification rubric
Pass: `rg -n 'run_etl_pipeline|DataFrameETLBackend|TPCDIMetrics|customer_mgmt_processor|finwire_processor|_legacy_etl' benchbox tests` prints nothing; the milestone step's integration tests still pass; `make duplicate-check-delta` and `make pr-preflight` pass.

## Guardrails (owner, 2026-11-20 and 2026-11-21)
- The agent never posts a stand-in review, closes and reopens a pull request to restart CI, uses `--no-verify`, force-pushes, rewrites an author, or deletes anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`.
- Arming: `make pr-arm` once; one more attempt only when the refusal named a cause, the agent reported it and the cause is cleared; never a third without asking. `make pr-rerun` at most once and only for a job the runner never ran or cancelled, never for a failed test.
- Review threads: reply; resolve only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise the finding again.
- Subagents are read-only. No file edit by script; use the edit tool. Do not edit a pull request description while its CI is starting; post a comment.
- Any limit, default, threshold, status token, message or label text the owner has not already chosen (see tpcdi-correction-plan-20261120) is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- A blocked step stops this item; no workaround. No live cloud run. Heavy work only through `make heavy-run`. One pull request for this item, merged before the next item starts.
- From the quarantine step until the reopening step, no TPC-DI entry point may produce a result that reads PASSED or is admitted for publication.
- Sources. SQL derived from the Databricks project (`src/incremental_batches/**` at commit 8e0f944, treated as MIT on the owner's instruction) may be committed only after the provenance step has merged, only under `benchbox/core/tpcdi/etl/`, with every file listed in `PROVENANCE.json` and with all comments removed.
- TPC and bankmark files (DIGen, PDGF, dictionaries, configuration, EULA, appendix SQL) come only from the official archive the owner supplies, are committed unmodified and only in the directories named in the tools step. Never copy from the Databricks project or the DuckDB implementation: their copies of the tools or the tools zip, DIGen output, generated reference files, audit snapshots, their copy or rewrite of the appendix SQL, or any generator code (`src/tools/**`). Never commit DIGen output.
- The specification wins over the Databricks project without asking. Each behaviour of the project that is kept and each change made to follow the specification is one row in `benchbox/core/tpcdi/etl/DEPARTURES.yaml`, which the owner approves at the milestone stop.
- A difference from the DuckDB implementation (djouallah/tpcdi) that is not in the written list of expected differences is a finding: it is triaged and listed in the pull request before the step is armed.
- Staging files produced by DIGen are never edited. The official audit, validation and visibility SQL is never edited in the repository.
